fields.Name: T181 - API Applications Panel Create
fields.Description: Covers the API Applications tab panel (scope-ceiling cards + create slide-out) inside API Keys — distinct from the separate 'Application Management' dashboard reached via the Apps sub-section.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'API Keys' sub-section. Click the 'Applications' tab in the L2 tab nav to open the API Applications panel (a grid of app cards, each showing a scope count and a Scope Ceiling Rules section when expanded). Click 'New Application' to open the create slide-out and verify the form renders with Application Name, Description, and an Active checkbox. Also try expanding an existing app card to reveal its scope-ceiling rules. Seeing the create slide-out form render (and/or a card expanding) is success — you do NOT need to save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Applications' tab shows the API Applications panel (app cards with scope counts, or a valid empty state)
Clicking 'New Application' opens a slide-out with Application Name, Description, and Active checkbox fields
Expanding an app card reveals a 'Scope Ceiling Rules' section (or a 'No scope rules defined' empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
